TRIAL ASSIGNED TO DEPARTMENT 503

JUDGE DESMOND, K.LEE/CLERK, P.DOWLING/CSR 09:27AM CAUSE CALLED FOR TRIAL BY COURT. DENNIS RUEL FOR THE PLTF. THE DEFT, CELESTE BUDDE, IS PRESENT IN PRO PER. WITNESSES S&E AND EXHIBITS IDENTIFIED AND ADMITTED INTO EVIDENCE. CASE TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BUDDE, CELESTE JUDGMENT IS RENDERED FOR PLTF, AWARDING POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES, FORFEITING THE LEASEHOLD AND AWARDING RENT AND DAMAGES OF $ 1,706.54. DEFT IS AWARDED COST OF SUIT. COST BILL TO BE FILED. THE PORTIONS OF THIS JUDGMENT AWARDING POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES TO PLTF AND DECLARING FORFEITURE OF THE LEASEHOLD ARE STAYED UNTIL MAY 21, 1998 ON CONDITION THAT DEFT PAY TO PLTF THE SUM OF $ 1,706.54.

ON OR BEFORE MAY 26, 1998,DEFT SHALL FILE WITH THE COURT AND SERVE ON PLTF PROOF IN THE FORM OF AFFIDAVIT SHOWING COMPLIANCE WITH THE SAID CONDITION. IF SUCH PROOF IS FILED AND SERVED, THE STAY ON THE WRIT OF EXECUTION WILL BE MADE PERMANENT AND DEFT WILL BE RESTORED TO HER TENANCY. IF SUCH PROOF IS NOT PROPERLY FILED AND SERVED, WRIT OF EXECUTION WILL ISSUE UPON VERIFIED APPLICATION OF PLTF SERVED ON DEFT WITHOUT HEARING.
